scope: Known historical development data; post-hoc exploratory extension; not a new unseen-sample confirmation
actual_input: Available daily fields are date, symbol, qfq open/high/low/close, volume, amount and turnover. Propose exactly three new factor hypotheses without reading or running the 2024-2025 holdout. Select one using only field reliability, economic rationale, distinction from the existing V1/V2 and implementability. The pre-specified redundancy benchmarks are 20-day momentum and 5-day reversal.

actual_output.name: turnover_shock_reversal
actual_output.economic_reason: A short-horizon price move accompanied by an abnormal turnover burst may contain temporary attention or liquidity pressure that subsequently mean-reverts.
actual_output.main_risk: May be a nonlinear repackaging of ordinary 5-day reversal; turnover comparability and corporate-event handling are imperfect.

actual_output.name: range_compression_breakout
actual_output.economic_reason: A trend formed with narrow intraday ranges may reflect steadier information diffusion than a trend dominated by wide-range noise.
actual_output.main_risk: Likely highly redundant with 20-day momentum and the old volatility-scaled V2.

actual_output.name: dollar_liquidity_improvement
actual_output.economic_reason: A recent improvement in price impact may proxy for improving investor breadth and lower required liquidity compensation.
actual_output.main_risk: Amount is strongly size-related while reliable historical market capitalization is unavailable for neutralization.

selection_reason: E1 is economically distinct from the old medium-term momentum family, uses directly observed fields, and its possible redundancy with 5-day reversal is explicitly measurable. E2 is too close to existing momentum/volatility logic; E3 cannot be adequately separated from size with the available data.
selection_rule: No numerical performance was used for hypothesis selection. Only E1 proceeds; no hypothesis search after results.
